summary: Bug: cancelling a widget does not archive it
description: PUT /api/widgets/{id}/cancel returned 200 but the widget's status stayed 'active' in the widgets table. Fixed in backend commit fictional-abc123 — status now transitions to 'archived'. A regression spec must prove the persistence, not just the 200. Bundled fake ticket used by /qa-selftest golden — endpoints are fictional.

comments.author: Backend Dev
comments.body: Root cause: the handler updated the response object but never wrote the status column. The fix persists status='archived'. Cancelling an unknown id returns 404.
